# `bit_count`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the number of bits that are set in the argument expr as an unsigned 64-bit integer, or NULL if the argument is NULL.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
bit_count(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bit_count, example 1
> SELECT bit_count(0);
0
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
